ITEM 1 | Pale off-white chunks with slightly fibrous, flaky edges and a light golden tint on the surface, scattered across the left side of the plate; pieces about 2-3 cm, holding shape, moist-looking, partly coated in creamy dressing | 110
ITEM 2 | Tan-brown grainy granules with small irregular clusters, matte surface, slightly moist, mixed throughout the center of the plate among the other pieces; clusters about 1-2 cm | 90
ITEM 3 | Dark purple-brown roasted cubes with browned, slightly charred edges and a glossy, somewhat wrinkled skin, about 2-3 cm, scattered on the right and lower-left of the plate | 85
ITEM 4 | Golden-yellow roasted cubes with browned edges and a soft, slightly crisp exterior, about 2 cm, clustered on the upper right beside the dark cubes | 60
ITEM 5 | Creamy off-white dressing with a slightly glossy, thick sheen, coating and binding the grains and chunks in the center, with small flecks of green herb visible | 40
ITEM 6 | Finely chopped bright green herbs and shreds, scattered in small amounts within the creamy mixture in the center-left, pieces under 1 cm | 5
